messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: SEV2 — cluster-nyc-1 reporting sustained KV resident page growth + pod restarts (12 restarts in 6m). Suspect paged-attention allocator fragmentation causing slow memory creep -> OOMs. Alert: https://internal.redwood/alerts/7177772000
oncall: Oncall here, grabbing logs and dashboards, will triage. :eyes:
sara: seeing repeated 'CUDA out of memory' from model-xxl-worker-7, stack traces show allocation failures during attention page faults.
ben: tracer shows KV cache map jumps in cardinality then gaps — pages pinned but not being reclaimed. Could be missing slab free path in recent allocator change.
leo: starting live mitigation steps: 1) disable autoscale burst, 2) move traffic away from nyc-1 to eu-west-2 for non-sensitive jobs, 3) reduce batch_size to 1 for high-latency requests.
oncall: execute step 1 and 3 now. Posting commands.
infra-bot: ran: ```kubectl -n runtime scale deployment model-xxl-worker --replicas=0 --context=nyc-1``` Result: 4 pods terminating, 0 running.
sara: applying eviction flag on KV cache for node groups: ```curl -X POST https://internal.redwood/api/v1/admin/kv/evict?node=nyc-1 -H 'Authorization: Bearer ***'``` Response: queued eviction job id=evict-717777.
ben: I see partial reclaim but fragmentation still high (free slabs fragmented). Recommendation: trigger controlled restart of allocator process to force defrag path on nodes with >70% resident.
leo: scheduling rolling restart for runtime pods in drain-safe mode. Command: `rgctl node drain nyc-1-03 && rgctl restart runtime-service --filter node=nyc-1-03`
oncall: doing coordinated restarts one node at a time, will mark nodes cordoned to avoid churn. Notifying customer-ops about potential short p95 spikes.
customer-ops: FYI: one enterprise customer reported 503s for embedders at ~11:12UTC. We flagged them and opened support ticket. ETA to update customer: 15m.
sara: attaching short log snippet of OOM: ```E cuda: out of memory when allocating 512MB (requested 134217728) at attention_pager.cpp:412
E runtime: aborting container restart loop after 3 failures
W allocator: slab_free path returned stale pointer -> leak?```
ben: quick patch idea: flip to passthrough small-kv mode for paged attention on affected nodes (disables complex slab allocations). Will prepare rollout.
leo: passthrough toggle ready, rolling to one node now. Monitoring GPU memory and page fault counters.
oncall: after toggle, node nyc-1-02 stabilized; no more OOMs for 6m. Overall restarts dropped from 12 -> 1 in that window.
sara: will file post-incident issue for allocator fix: reproducer + min testcase. Adding labels: pager, allocator, cuda, oncall-handoff.
customer-ops: Updated customer — incident impact limited, service degraded but fallback applied; we offered postmortem and credit.
infra-bot: Incident ticket updated: https://internal.redwood/incidents/7177772000 with actions: eviction job, passthrough toggle, rolling restarts, customer comms.
oncall: handing off to day team for follow-up. Next steps: root-cause triage, bisect allocator change, create small repro and run memcheck on paged-attn, propose hotfix to allocator free path.
ben: ack, I'll take the bisect. Leaving notes in the ticket. :thumbsup:
sara: tagging engineering-ml and eng-runtime for wakeup. Good job everyone. :clap:
